scope: Provider-neutral local request/event validation and durable reconciliation; no provider SDK execution claim
invariants: Persist request before caller dispatch; identical idempotency key and payload reuse without redispatch; altered content rejected
Reject malformed, duplicate/non-finite JSON, unknown fields, booleans as token limits and event identity drift
An ambiguous dispatch/timeout stays unknown until a matching provider observation; never auto-retry an external effect
Cancel intent is not terminal proof; later success or explicit cancellation acknowledgement settles it
Repeated identical event is idempotent; changed duplicate or contradictory terminal observation rejected
SQLite transaction preserves durable history across process reopen; local store lock is not provider-global enforcement
Unavailable usage is null, never zero or invented provider identity
acceptance: real CLI persistence and idempotent retry
live_gate: Authorized provider endpoint/identity and actual observation contract required before claiming live execution
